trust_decision.summary: UrlSanitizer::parse() decides whether a URL from an untrusted HTML attribute is safe to re-emit; its deny gate only matched raw BiDi marks and ASCII whitespace, so percent-encoded BiDi marks and raw/encoded Unicode whitespace passed into the rendered href/src.

landing_point.why: The existing BiDi preg_match is the only 'URL deny gate' in HtmlSanitizer; the summary names the URL parser deny gates directly.

fix_sites.entry_point: HtmlSanitizer::sanitize()/sanitizeFor() and Twig sanitize_html filter -> DomVisitor -> UrlAttributeSanitizer -> UrlSanitizer::sanitize -> parse (raw deny pattern widened to Unicode whitespace)
same chain; new per-component rawurldecode check on user/pass/host/path/query/fragment after UriString::parse (fix.diff:91-97)
same chain; shared DENIED_CHARS_PATTERN class constant (fix.diff:61-66)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published changes are in src/Symfony/Component/HtmlSanitizer/TextSanitizer/UrlSanitizer.php; no second implementation, wrapper or lower-level API was changed.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: srcset/imagesrcset are comma/whitespace-separated URL lists with descriptors (whitespace is legitimate there) and longdesc/manifest/usemap are legacy or non-navigational, so a solver can argue the 'URL parser' advisory only covers the attributes UrlAttributeSanitizer already routes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: ASCII spaces in path/query/fragment must keep being tolerated and percent-encoded (and legitimate non-ASCII paths/IDN hosts like 你好 or Ｇｏ.com must keep passing); an over-broad \s or non-ASCII ban, or rejecting all %20 after decoding, breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: percent-encoded BiDi marks in path/query/fragment (upper and lower case hex)
raw Unicode whitespace (NBSP, U+1680, U+2000-200A, U+2028/2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+0085)
raw and percent-encoded U+FEFF zero-width no-break space, including inside host

O8_uncovered_routes.route: srcset / imagesrcset attributes (allowed by allowSafeElements) carry URLs into the rendered HTML without ever passing through UrlAttributeSanitizer, so neither raw nor encoded BiDi/whitespace is denied there.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Multi-URL list syntax with whitespace descriptors; never covered by URL sanitizer; arguably a separate 'unsanitized URL attribute' issue.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: longdesc / manifest / usemap attributes are safe-listed but not in UrlAttributeSanitizer's supported attribute list, so URL deny gates never run on them.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legacy / non-navigational attributes not rendered as clickable links.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A srcset-aware attribute sanitizer that splits candidates on commas/whitespace and validates each URL with its own lighter check instead of UrlSanitizer::parse.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: srcset needs a separate parser; a maintainer would plausibly write a dedicated splitter with its own scheme check and forget the BiDi/whitespace gate (how-type: separator split).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Host check that decodes only unreserved characters; an IDN/punycode normalisation step for allowed-hosts matching that runs after the deny gate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Allowed-host matching on Unicode hosts is a natural feature; normalising after the check creates a rename-after-check differential.

O9_family: UI misrepresentation / visual spoofing via URL characters (incomplete deny-list, encoding bypass)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.1+, composer (league/uri, masterminds/html5), PHPUnit via symfony/phpunit-bridge

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the percent-encoded BiDi sequences (e.g. %E2%80%AE) as literal strings to the existing raw preg_match, missing lowercase hex, Unicode whitespace and per-component decoding.

out_of_scope_notes: Forced attributes bypass attribute sanitizers (DomVisitor.php:122-123) but are developer-configured, not untrusted input.
VarExporter Exporter.php:226 escapes BiDi marks in exported code; unrelated component.
